local_facts.title: A survival action can be separate from wrongful death
local_facts.claim: Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code section 71.021 says a personal-injury cause of action does not abate because the injured person died and survives to the heirs, legal representatives, and estate.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A death-related review may need to distinguish the family's losses from an injury claim that belonged to the person who died. The records and estate questions can differ.

local_facts.title: Austin has a local civil-court process
local_facts.claim: Travis County lists its Civil and Family Courts at 1700 Guadalupe Street in Austin. Its District Civil Courts have original jurisdiction over civil matters involving damages of $200 or more, and the District Clerk says attorneys must e-file civil documents.
local_facts.why_it_matters: Death-related civil matters require attention to local filing, service, record, and scheduling procedures rather than informal paperwork alone.

local_facts.title: Fatal crashes are a documented Travis County issue
local_facts.claim: TxDOT's 2024 Crashes and Injuries by County table reports 139 fatal crashes and 155 traffic fatalities in Travis County.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A fatal-crash review may need to preserve crash reports, vehicle information, witness material, video, and insurance communications before the record becomes harder to reconstruct.
